candidates.statement: Order service postgres connection pool is exhausted (size 5, idle 0), causing save_order to fail with DependencyUnavailable and checkout to return 502 after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side traces/logs/metrics were excluded by context budget; pool saturation inferred from gateway spans only. Deployment record does not establish causation.

report.explanation: All four checkout requests fail with 502 after ~2s; traces show postgres.save_order erroring with DependencyUnavailable while pool size=5 and idle=0, and order calls time out. Bounded candidate is db-pool-exhaustion; order-side telemetry is needed to confirm.
missing_evidence: order service traces/logs/metrics confirming postgres pool saturation and connection wait times
postgres server-side connection and saturation metrics
